title: SE Orchestrator Output Schema
description: Orchestration metadata output from the se-orchestrator agent. Intentionally separate from se-decomposition.schema.json which covers the decomposition data.

orchestration_id.description: Unique identifier for this orchestration session (e.g., ORCH-001).

level.description: Current recursion level of the orchestration.

cells_spawned.description: List of child cells spawned for sub-component decomposition.

component_id.description: ID of the component being decomposed in this cell.

input_checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum of the cell input for idempotence verification.

leaf_components.description: Components that reached leaf status and are ready for handover.

level.description: Level at which this component became a leaf.

handover_ready.description: Whether the component is ready for handover to implementing disciplines.

decomposition_ref.description: Reference to the se-decomposition.schema.json output for this component.

propagation_map_ref.description: Reference to the interface propagation map (e.g., IFM-001).

traceability.description: Zig-zag traceability links across decomposition levels.

vv_status.description: Verification & Validation status across the V-model.

requirements_verified.description: Whether requirements have passed critic verification.

architecture_verified.description: Whether architecture has passed critic verification.

integration_test_planned.description: Whether integration tests have been planned.

system_validation_pending.description: Whether L1 system validation (User Journeys) is still pending.

next_actions.description: Recommended next actions for the orchestrator.
